LET’S MAKE THINGS CLEARER

It’s okay to
have questions.

And it’s okay to ask them again.

Is home ICU care right for my family member?+

Suitability depends on the patient’s condition, clinical needs, and home environment. The care team should assess this with the treating doctor before you make any arrangements.

What happens after I get in touch?+

You can discuss the support you need, your location, and your questions with the Kokoro team. Ask them to confirm availability, clinical assessment, timing, and a written care plan before proceeding.

Can I arrange care after a hospital discharge?+

You can enquire about recovery support ahead of discharge. Share the treating doctor’s recommendations directly with the care team through an agreed secure channel, so they can assess what is appropriate.

How is the cost of care decided?+

Costs depend on the services, staffing, equipment, location, and duration involved. Request an itemised quote from the team, including any deposits or additional charges.

Where is care available?+

Availability varies by city and service. Include your city in your enquiry so the team can confirm the options available at your location.
